name: Bases
description: Obsidian Bases: .base files as tables, cards and lists, bases embedded in notes, the writer-bases agent skill and the writer base commands.

memory.note: The base view, its editing menus and the embed widgets load when a .base file or a note with an embedded base is first shown; nothing runs in the background. The Rust half (query commands, the writer base commands and the writer-bases skill) takes effect at the next launch.
